create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph with start and accept nodes then add weighted arcs between them
save_and_load_graph: save a GTN graph to a file using savetxt or save then load it back with loadtxt or load
perform_scalar_graph_operations: create scalar graphs and perform arithmetic operations like negate add and subtract on them
compute_gradients_with_autograd: enable calc_grad on a graph then call backward to compute gradients through graph operations
run_parallel_graph_operations: apply operations like negate add or concat in parallel across lists of graphs using gtn functions
